messages:
frank: Kickoff — provisioning new cloud account + VPC for south-america region (sa-east-1 / "scl") to host a dedicated GPU inference pool. Pilot scope: prod-ish infra for LatAm customers, private-only access, Dedicated GPU nodes (H100 preferred, fallback A10G). Starting terraform scaffold now; tagging/ownership and quota requests are blockers.
julia: Thanks. Can you confirm CIDR plan? we should avoid overlapping with corp-transit and customers' VPN ranges.
alex: Proposal: 10.200.0.0/18 for shared VPC + 10.201.0.0/20 for GPU-enclave VPC (separate account). Keeps 8k+ hosts headroom.
rachel: +1 on separate enclave. Need flow logs to central-logging account, VPC endpoints for S3/ECR/STS, and private KMS key with cross-account policy. Also require an IAM role for security-scan service.
frank: Noted. I'll create CMK in the new account and share ARN with security. Also adding required endpoints.
infra-bot: Checklist (auto):
- create account: redwood-scl-gpu-prod
- terraform module: infra-aws-vpc v2.1.0
- CMK: create + attach policy to security and ops account
- Flow logs: to central-logs S3 bucket + Athena partitioning
- Endpoints: s3, ecr.dkr, sts, ssm, ec2messages
- Tags: cost_center=infra; owner=ml-platform; env=prod; region=scl
- Quota requests: EC2 GPU FPs (H100), ENI limits, EBS gp3 throughput
frank: I'll post the terraform snippet I'm about to apply: 
```
module "vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo.redwood.com/infra/terraform-aws-vpc.git//modules/shared"
  name   = "redwood-scl-shared"
  cidr   = "10.200.0.0/18"
  azs    = ["sa-east-1a","sa-east-1b","sa-east-1c"]
  enable_flow_logs = true
  enable_dns_hostnames = true
}
module "gpu_enclave" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo.redwood.com/infra/terraform-aws-vpc.git//modules/enclave"
  name   = "redwood-scl-gpu"
  cidr   = "10.201.0.0/20"
  private_subnet_cidrs = ["10.201.0.0/24","10.201.1.0/24","10.201.2.0/24"]
  nat_gateways = 0
}
```
manny: FYI ops: we'll want a dedicated NAT/egress pattern via central-nat in a transit account, or use Egress-only endpoints if possible. Avoid per-enclave internet egress for cost and auditing.
alex: Quota request: open support ticket now for H100 family and ENA/eni limits. Ask for 16 H100s initially with burst to 32. Submit with expected vCPU draw and use-case (inference).
rachel: Security reminder — require private-bastion in shared-services account for any admin access. No direct internet RDP/SSH. Also put SSM session-manager enabled.
frank: Will do. Also planning: EKS cluster in GPU account with custom AMI + device plugin. Can someone pre-create the IAM OIDC provider and node instance role?
infra-bot: Action created: create-oidc-provider (assigned to alex), create-node-role (assigned to julia).
julia: I'll create node role + nodegroup IAM policies. Need the exact AMI family; alex can provide build id.
alex: AMI plan: redwood-gpu-h100-ami:v1 (packer build pending). ETA tomorrow.
ops-bot: Acceptance smoke tests to run after bring-up: 
1) from bastion: curl -sS http://internal-nlb.health/ready -> expect 200
2) kubectl get nodes -> GPU nodes in Ready state and 'nvidia.com/gpu' allocatable
3) run small inference job: `kubectl run -it --rm --image=ghcr.io/redwood/smoke-infer:latest test-infer -- python client.py --model local --prompt "hello"` -> expect 1-2s latency
4) validate flow logs visible in central Athena within 30m

manny: Handoff checklist for Solutions Eng:
- confirm quotas granted
- confirm CMK sharing and cross-account IAM
- confirm VPC peering / TGW route tables are updated
- confirm terraform plan + apply runbook in infra pipeline
- run smoke tests above and report success/fail with logs
Please own the ticket for the next 48h. I'll coordinate capacity plan for initial release.
frank: Cost estimate: roughly $55k/mo reserved if we keep 16 H100s on-demand. If we commit reserved (1yr) we can shave ~30%. I'll attach spreadsheet to the ticket.
julia: Small ask: add cost-allocation tag `project=latam-pilot` to all resources.
rachel: Also enable GuardDuty + Config recording in this account.
frank: Good call. I'll include that in terraform variables.
alex: I put the quota request ticket in (AWS case 1234567890). Tagging: infra/priority=high.
infra-bot: Reminder: create DNS delegation record with dns-team once shared VPC is up.
manny: After quotas + AMI land I'll run the perf bench to validate throughput per-gpu. Expect to test p99 tail latency at 512 tokens.
frank: OK team — next steps: I'll apply terraform to create accounts/VPCs today in dry-run, then schedule apply for 02:00 UTC tomorrow. Julia/Alex/Manny/Rachel: please watch the run and be ready for rollback. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Logging this thread to runbook ticket RED-OPS-4521.
frank: Thanks — ping me in thread if anything blocks.
